title: Tech View starts with List's default columns and saved List choices stay
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011). A desktop browser with the window at least 1024 pixels wide (full screen on an ordinary laptop or monitor). Below that width the page shows only List.
  • [User-A]: an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • [User-B] = "Nora New" (the expected results name her, so keep this name): a brand-new user who has never changed any Work Orders columns, created under Settings > Staff with an Admin role, signed in in a second browser.
  • One location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); everything below is created in this location.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Default Columns" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset, so this case's work orders are kept apart from every other work order at the location.
  • One Approved work order for that customer, [WO-1], with one line and Lead Technician left empty.
  • [User-A]'s List may start with any columns; the steps set them.

Setup

  1. Sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page (you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Check the location in the top bar next to the bell; to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  2. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff > New Staff Member with an email you can open for "Nora New", role = Admin, at least one Department (required), with this location picked in Location > Save & Close, then accept the invitation and set a password. Keep her signed in in a second browser.
  3. Top menu Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Default Columns" > Save (if it already exists, open it instead). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, TRK-118) > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty.
  4. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Default Columns" and its Asset > Save, and record its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). Leave Lead Technician empty. The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved so the work order status reads Approved, and click Save & Close.
  5. Check the setup worked: Nora New can sign in and opens Work Orders without having changed any column; Work Orders > All tab > Search ZZAUTOTEST F2 Tech Default Columns shows [WO-1], status Approved, with no lead. If Nora New already existed and changed columns, create a fresh user instead.
custom_steps:
1. As Nora New open Work Orders in List and write down every column shown.
  2. Pick Tech View and write down every column shown.
  3. Open Tech View's Column Selection menu and read whether Assigned Techs is on.
  4. As your own user, open List, turn Service Advisor off and Created on on, then reload.
  5. Pick Tech View, change any column there, pick List again and reload.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Nora New's Tech View shows exactly the same columns as her List default (the production List defaults); Assigned Techs is off until she turns it on.
  • Your List keeps Service Advisor off and Created on on after every switch and reload: saved List choices stay exactly as they are. (Choices saved before this release cannot be recreated by hand; write 'pre-release List choice not checked' unless you have such a user.)

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10048 (Story 5, Fields to display (Board View) and columns (Tech View)); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S5-R4, S5-R12, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions FF-7 / DR-21. Tech plan §3.9 records the production default List columns. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-R4: “Until the user changes Tech View’s columns, Tech View shows the current production List default columns.”
  • S5-R12: “Existing saved List column selections stay exactly as they are.”
  • Tech plan §3.9 (default List columns): “Default List columns = every non-required column except `invoicedDate`, `daysOpen`, `partRequestsCount`, `partReturnRequestsCount`, `unreceivedPartRequestsCount`.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
